description: Carry Workflow Action success output as a structured JSON object or null from runner production through server persistence and consumers, expose named core/process fields, and render structured task output directly in Web task details.

tasks.title: Implement structured Workflow Action output end to end
tasks.description: Atomically migrate the runner Action boundary, shared report envelope, server Workflow boundary, task-status API, and Web consumers from serialized output strings to structured JSON. Convert all built-in Action producers and runner consumers, add object-or-null validation, expose core/process as {stdout, exitCode}, preserve check and AgentJob behavior at their domain boundaries, and project the same object into setVars, recovery, task references, dynamic artifact capture, approval-feedback summaries, persistence, and task details. Remove Web output reparsing in the same deliverable so no intermediate revision drops task output.
acceptanceCriteria: ActionResult success output is typed as JsonObject | null, succeed accepts that shape, and one runtime validator shared by task and check execution rejects a string (including serialized object text), array, scalar, cyclic object, non-finite number, undefined/function/bigint value, or other non-JSON value with the existing unexpected-error platform code and an actionable message that successful Action output must be a JSON object or null; validation occurs before completion, recovery output matching, artifact capture, or setVars runs, while null remains a successful output.

core/process success output is exactly {stdout: <trimmed standard output>, exitCode: <numeric exit code>}; its existing top-level WorkItemResult.exitCode fact remains available, and runner tests prove output.stdout and output.exitCode retain string and number types.

Every other built-in Action returns its established output object directly with unchanged field names, values, and JSON types; production Action paths no longer JSON.stringify successful public output, and their existing tests assert object fields without JSON.parse compatibility helpers.

setVars traverses the Action output object directly and sends one Run Variables PATCH only after all source paths resolve; a core/process task can project output.stdout and output.exitCode, while a missing source path or null output fails the task, names the source path, and applies none of that task's variable patch.

Recovery when: output.* matching, failure.output.* expansion, and dynamic producedArtifacts discovery consume the same Action output object directly with no output-string parsing or wrapping; existing recovery and artifact semantics remain covered by runner tests.

WorkItemResult.output carries JsonValue | null and ServerConnection.report emits nested JSON. RunnerReportRequest.Output, WorkResult.Output, and TaskReport.Output carry JsonElement?; explicit JSON null is canonicalized to nullable null, valid task objects are assigned directly to TaskRun.Output, and ParseOutputToJsonElement plus its string-wrapping fallback are removed.

WorkflowItemTranslator rejects a task report whose output is not an object or null by producing and acknowledging a durable failed task report; it does not apply Workflow object-root validation to checks or AgentJobs.

A completed task's persisted object is projected under tasks.<definitionId>.outputs without conversion, and an integration spec proves a later task resolves ${{ tasks.process.outputs.stdout }} to a string and ${{ tasks.process.outputs.exitCode }} to a number. Historical non-object TaskRun output is neither rewritten nor projected as valid task output.

Check dispatch output is a structured result-row array whose passing rows contain object-or-null Action output, and server check translation consumes the JsonElement array directly. AgentJob report/terminal-output and failure-category behavior remain unchanged through an explicit Agent adapter; focused regression tests cover both shared-envelope variants.

TaskStatusView.Output is JsonElement? and server status/timeline responses expose object-valued TaskRun output as a nested JSON object or null, mapping historical non-object values to null; API/spec tests cover core/process output, another built-in Action output, null output, and invalid report rejection.

A completed approval-feedback task using core/process derives ResolutionSummary from output.stdout through the existing ExtractResolutionSummary logic; a null output or output object from an Action without an explicit feedback-text adapter resolves feedback with a null summary and is never JSON-serialized into summary text. Focused server unit/spec coverage verifies process stdout, section stripping, arbitrary object output, and null output.
WorkflowTimelineTask.output and related Web task-state inputs accept Record<string, unknown> | null (or the repository's equivalent structured JSON type), not string output.

parseTimelineTaskOutput, the TaskProgressPanel-local parseTaskOutput helper, and string JSON parsing fallbacks used for task-output/delivery metadata are removed; StageBar and TaskProgressPanel pass API output directly to the existing structured-output renderer.

A completed core/process task with {stdout: "release-ready", exitCode: 0} displays both fields and their values in every task-detail/progress surface without an intermediate JSON.parse; null output renders no fabricated object or wrapped string.

Existing built-in PR delivery output remains discoverable from object-valued task output with unchanged prNumber, prUrl, mergeCommitSha, and targetBranch semantics; task status, failure guidance, logs, artifacts, and reading-flow layout remain unchanged.
Web unit/spec coverage exercises structured core/process output, structured PR output, and null output in both StageBar and TaskProgressPanel paths.

The built-in mohist/github-pr profile regression covers its existing setVars fields, task-output references, recovery output matching, and unchanged Action output fields using the structured report contract.

design/workflow/actions.md no longer lists string Action output and core/process bare stdout as an implementation gap; no Action manifest, input validation, output declaration/schema, or new Workflow YAML syntax is introduced.

npm run typecheck -w packages/runner, npm test -w packages/runner, npm test, npm run typecheck -w packages/web, and npm run test:run -w packages/web all pass with no real network, process, filesystem, database service, or wall-clock dependency added to tests.
tasks.output: Structured Action/result types and validation across packages/runner; JsonElement runner-report, Workflow persistence/projection, and task-status API across packages/server; direct structured-output rendering across packages/web; runner/server/Web regression tests; and the closed output gap in design/workflow/actions.md
tasks.notes: This is one atomic task because runner/server wire formats and the server/Web task-output API are incompatible in mixed versions. Keep ActionResult.output narrower (JsonObject | null) than shared WorkItemResult.output (JsonValue | null). Key boundaries: packages/runner/src/core/types.ts, actions/action-result.ts, runtime/executor.ts, runtime/check-execution.ts, runtime/set-vars.ts, runtime/recovery.ts, runtime/artifact-capture.ts, server/connection.ts; packages/server Api/RunnerRoutes.cs, Runner/Grains/IRunnerGrain.cs, Runner/Services/WorkflowItemTranslator.cs, Workflow/Domain/Run/WorkItem.cs, Workflow/Domain/Run/WorkflowRun.Approval.cs, Workflow/Grains/WorkflowWorkLifecycle.cs, Workflow/Services/WorkflowDispatchHelpers.cs, Workflow/Services/WorkflowStatusMapper.cs, and AgentJob report handling; packages/web entities/issue/model/workflow-timeline.ts, widgets/issue-workflow/ui/format.ts, StageBar.tsx, TaskProgressPanel.tsx, shared/lib/pr-delivery.ts, and their tests. Preserve the current Web renderer/layout and do not wire the disconnected capturedOutputs field into the server.
